visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of a modern, three-story white guesthouse in Yilan. In the foreground, a large white crescent moon decoration stands on a concrete patio. To the left, a swimming pool with clear water reflects the overcast sky. A lush green lawn and palm trees surround the building. (2) Inside, a young boy in a black long-sleeved shirt explores a brightly lit children's playroom. The room features light wood flooring and is filled with various toys, including a miniature wooden kitchen set, a small purple and white indoor slide, and colorful play mats on the ground. (3) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a beige knitted sweater and light blue jeans, jumps joyfully in front of the guesthouse exterior. Large yellow and orange text overlays appear next to her, introducing the "Spring is Warm" guesthouse while she gestures toward the modern architecture. (4) A series of close-up shots showcase an array of meticulously prepared desserts and snacks. These include miniature sliders with green sprouts, delicate lemon tarts, fruit cups with strawberries and pineapple, and small savory sandwiches arranged on wooden platters and gold-colored wire stands. (5) The camera pans through the interior living space, featuring a neutral-toned sectional sofa and a round wooden coffee table. An automatic mahjong table is shown in a separate area, followed by a child sitting on the sofa singing into a microphone, while a woman holds a baby nearby. (6) At night, the pool area is illuminated with warm artificial lights. The moon decoration glows softly. Children are seen sliding down a grass-covered embankment on plastic sleds. Inside the playroom, children play with a yellow Pikachu-themed inflatable toy and jump into a colorful ball pit. (7) A man wearing a light blue sweater and a black cap stands outside near a blue and white food truck labeled "Carbon Brothers." He gestures toward the truck as it unfolds its side panels. Close-up shots show chicken wings and steaks grilling over hot coals with visible smoke. (8) The family gathers indoors around the mahjong table, with the woman holding the baby while others play. The video concludes with a young girl smiling and waving from behind a white curtain in a brightly lit room, accompanied by final text overlays for the guesthouse.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An upbeat, high-tempo acoustic pop track begins, featuring bright guitar strumming and a light, rhythmic percussion. A male narrator introduces the guesthouse with a very enthusiastic, high-pitched vocal delivery. The sound of the wind or outdoor ambience is extremely faint, overshadowed by the music. (2) As visual features are mentioned, subtle digital "ping" and "sparkle" sound effects are layered over the BGM. The narrator's speech rate is fast and energetic, maintaining a friendly and professional tone. Faint sounds of children's laughter and chatter are mixed into the background to enhance the atmosphere. (3) The music continues at a steady pace while the narrator describes the food and tea party. High-frequency "pop" and "whoosh" sound effects transition between shots of the desserts. The male narrator's voice remains dominant with clear articulation, exhibiting a positive emotional valence and high arousal. (4) During the interior tour, the BGM volume ducks slightly to allow the narrator to highlight the mahjong table and karaoke system. A short snippet of a child singing through a microphone is audible, followed by the sound of mechanical mahjong tiles being shuffled and clicked into place. (5) The audio texture shifts as the scene changes to nighttime. The BGM maintains its tempo, but the ambient floor becomes quieter. The narrator's voice takes on a slightly warmer, more inviting tone while describing the pool's romantic lighting. A "ding" sound effect marks a key visual highlight. (6) The sound of plastic sleds sliding on grass and children shouting excitedly in the playroom is clearly audible. These incidental noises are well-balanced with the music. The narrator continues with an animated, high-energy delivery, emphasizing the fun experiences available for families and kids. (7) A transition sound effect leads into the food truck segment. The male narrator introduces the "Carbon Brothers" service. The distinct sizzling sound of meat on a grill is added to the mix, creating a sensory appeal. The narrator's tone remains authoritative yet very friendly and welcoming. (8) In the final phase, the BGM volume increases slightly as the narrator provides a closing invitation. The voices of children playing mahjong and chatting are heard in the background. The music reaches a natural cadence and fades out smoothly, ending the audio track on a positive note.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog for a guesthouse in Yilan called "Spring is Warm" (春日暖暖). It highlights family-friendly amenities like a pink pool, grass slide, playroom, and specialized catering services (food truck) to attract tourists looking for a relaxing family getaway.
